scenario.help = LE PONT DU MAL: THE EVIL BRIDGE
content.brief: An American convoy is headed south towards the bridge and have orders to capture and hold it until reinforcements arrive. A small German unit is camped in town and are desperate to defend the bridge from capture.
content.title: Le pont du mal WIP
